item.description: Deadline: December 13, 2026 Applications are open for the Arab American Leadership Program (AALP) 2027. Established in 2021, the Arab American Leadership Program (AALP) is building a career pipeline for emerging leaders to serve in public policy, government and civic leadership. [...]
